entries: tests/_gate_teeth_canaries_cuda_fit_at_test_module_import.py: named for the existing loader glob _gate_teeth_canaries_cuda_*.py; the gate is not a CUDA gate
corpus_drift: tests_root binding already exists; no NON_CORPUS entry needed
registry.toml: needs a kind=gate entry with the min_files and allow_unparsed keys
summary: A test module (test_*.py, *_test.py, conftest.py) must not call .fit, .fit_transform or .fit_predict (configurable heavy_calls) at import time: module level, class body, decorators and default arguments. Function and lambda bodies are not reported. Waiver: # import-fit-ok: <reason> on any line the call spans. Incident: mlframe macOS shards held in collection for three hours.
changelog: - **New gate `fit_at_test_module_import` (audit 50-T5).** Flags a test module that trains a model while it is imported (module or class-level `.fit`-style calls); waive with `# import-fit-ok: <reason>`. No behaviour change for consumers until it is registered.
